title: Scouter document
description: Canonical, strict contract for a Scouter protocol v1 native Android overlay. The complete UTF-8 JSON payload is limited to 256 KiB; the content tree is limited to 120 nodes and 12 nested levels.

version.description: Protocol version. The only supported value is 1.

id.description: Stable document identity. Re-sending the same ID replaces and selects the existing visible or queued view.

title.description: Optional title shown in the sheet header and used as the notification title when notification.title is absent.

titleIcon.description: Optional semantic icon shown beside the sheet title and reused for notifications when notification.icon is absent.

notification.description: Optional text and semantic icon for minimized or lock-screen notifications.

presentation.description: Sheet lifecycle controls. Set minimizable to true explicitly when the card must display a Minimize action.

content.description: Root of the native UI component tree.

color.description: Hex color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form; the optional final byte is alpha.

elementId.description: Stable semantic ID: 1–80 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens.

icon.description: A semantic Material icon. A string uses all defaults; an object controls placement, tint, size, and spacing; null displays no icon.

position.description: Places the icon before or after adjacent text.

color.description: Optional icon tint. By default the surrounding content color is used.

spacing.description: Space in density-independent pixels between the icon and text.

notification.description: Overrides notification content. Missing values are derived from the document title, title icon, and first useful content text.

title.description: Notification title. Falls back to document.title, then content, then "Scouter".

message.description: Notification body. Falls back to the first useful content text that differs from the title.

icon.description: Semantic notification glyph. Falls back to titleIcon, then the Scouter app glyph.

cornerRadius.description: Default sheet corner radius in density-independent pixels. Individual components use their own defaults unless style.radius overrides them.

presentation.description: Controls which sheet actions are available. By default Close is enabled and Minimize is disabled.

dismissible.description: When true, displays the Close action. Defaults to true.

minimizable.description: MUST be true to display the Minimize action and permit user- or preference-driven minimization. Omitting it disables those paths. Locked-screen delivery is queued independently of this flag. Every notification path requires Android notification permission.

showHandle.description: Requests the pull handle. It is only rendered when the user's configured pull-down action is allowed by dismissible or minimizable.

maxHeight.description: Maximum sheet height as a fraction of the available screen height.

horizontalMargin.description: Sheet margin from each horizontal screen edge in density-independent pixels.

radius.description: Optional sheet corner radii. When absent, theme.cornerRadius is used.

insets.description: Insets in density-independent pixels. A number applies to all sides. In object form, side values override horizontal or vertical shorthands.

radius.description: Corner radii in density-independent pixels. A number applies to all corners; named corners override all in object form.

vibrateSequence.description: Android waveform durations in milliseconds: delay, vibrate, pause, vibrate, and so on. Maximum total duration: 15000 ms.

style.description: Common layout and decoration applied to any component. Numeric dimensions are density-independent pixels.

weight.description: Relative width when this component is a direct child of a row. It has no effect in other parents.

border.description: Border decoration. If the object exists and width is omitted, width defaults to 1 dp.

borderWidth.description: Legacy flat alias for border.width. Prefer border.width.

borderColor.description: Legacy flat alias for border.color. Prefer border.color.

routeLocation.description: One route location, either a non-blank address string or an object containing exactly one address or latitude/longitude pair.

action.description: Action performed by an interactive component. If action is omitted, the component remains visible but performs no external action.

type.description: Closes the originating document and removes its notification.

label.description: Legacy checklist-item button label. Prefer the checklist item's buttonLabel.

oneOf.description: Opens an ordered multi-stop route in Google Maps. When origin is omitted, routing begins at the device's current location. The final stops entry is the destination and earlier entries are waypoints.

stops.description: Ordered locations to visit. The last entry is the destination; preceding entries are waypoints. Google Maps support varies by platform and may limit mobile-browser fallback to three waypoints.

label.description: Legacy checklist-item button label. Prefer the checklist item's buttonLabel.

closeAfter.description: When true, closes the document after Android successfully opens the route. Otherwise it remains visible unless minimizable is true and the user's Minimize after actions preference is enabled.

label.description: Legacy checklist-item button label. Prefer the checklist item's buttonLabel.

closeAfter.description: When true, closes the document after Android successfully opens the URL. Otherwise it remains visible unless minimizable is true and the user's Minimize after actions preference is enabled.

label.description: Legacy checklist-item button label. Prefer the checklist item's buttonLabel.

package.description: Optional target Android package. Set it to avoid exposing callbacks to unrelated apps.

extras.description: Additional values converted to string extras. Scouter also adds scouter_id, element_id, event, and value when available.

closeAfter.description: Closes the originating document after sending the callback.

label.description: Legacy checklist-item button label. Prefer the checklist item's buttonLabel.

closeAfter.description: When true, closes the document after Android successfully opens navigation. Otherwise it remains visible unless minimizable is true and the user's Minimize after actions preference is enabled.

label.description: Legacy checklist-item button label. Prefer the checklist item's buttonLabel.

closeAfter.description: When true, closes the document after Android successfully opens the dialer. Otherwise it remains visible unless minimizable is true and the user's Minimize after actions preference is enabled.

gap.description: Vertical space between children in density-independent pixels.

row.description: Lays children out horizontally. Children with style.weight share the remaining width.

gap.description: Horizontal space between children in density-independent pixels.

grid.description: Places children in a fixed-column grid.

horizontalGap.description: Horizontal gap in dp; defaults to gap, or 12 when gap is absent.

verticalGap.description: Vertical gap in dp; defaults to gap, or 12 when gap is absent.

box.description: Positions one child inside an alignment box.

text.description: Native text with semantic typography and optional icon.

oneOf.description: Legacy typography alias. Prefer variant and reserve style for the style object.

button.description: Tap button. If action is omitted, taps are accepted but intentionally perform no action.

oneOf.description: Legacy visual variant alias. Prefer variant.

holdButton.description: Press-and-hold confirmation control. Releasing before durationMs cancels completion.

slideAction.description: Drag-to-confirm control. The action runs after the thumb crosses threshold.

height.description: Default image height in dp; style.height takes precedence when provided.

cornerRadius.description: Default image radius in dp; style.radius takes precedence when provided.

checklist.description: Persistent checkbox list. State is keyed by document ID, checklist ID, and item ID. Each item may also expose an independent action.

checked.description: Initial value used only until persisted state exists.

buttonLabel.description: Visible label for the optional item action button, or its accessibility label when actionIcon is set. Defaults to Navigate, Open, Dial, Run, or Close based on the action type.

actionIcon.description: When set, replaces the visible action text with this icon.

action.description: Optional callback run after any checkbox changes. Broadcast callbacks receive event=change, element_id=item.id, and value=true or false.

link.description: Single tappable HTTP(S) link opened through Android.

linkList.description: List of tappable HTTP(S) links, optionally with persistent checkboxes.

checkable.description: Adds persistent checkboxes. When true, the list ID is required.

checked.description: Initial value used only until persisted state exists.

address.description: Single address row whose action opens Android navigation.

closeAfter.description: When true, closes after navigation opens. Otherwise the document remains visible unless minimizable is true and the user's Minimize after actions preference is enabled.

addressList.description: List of address navigation rows, optionally with persistent checkboxes.

checkable.description: Adds persistent checkboxes. When true, the list ID is required.

checked.description: Initial value used only until persisted state exists.

closeAfter.description: When true, closes after navigation opens. Otherwise the document remains visible unless minimizable is true and the user's Minimize after actions preference is enabled.

phone.description: Single phone row that opens Android's dialer without placing a call.

closeAfter.description: When true, closes after the dialer opens. Otherwise the document remains visible unless minimizable is true and the user's Minimize after actions preference is enabled.

phoneList.description: List of dialer actions, optionally with persistent checkboxes.

checkable.description: Adds persistent checkboxes. When true, the list ID is required.

checked.description: Initial value used only until persisted state exists.

actionList.description: Mixed address, phone, and HTTP(S) link actions, optionally with persistent checkboxes.

checkable.description: Adds persistent checkboxes. When true, the list ID is required.

map.description: Embedded native Google map. Rendering requires a valid build-time MAPS_API_KEY; otherwise a configuration message is shown.

height.description: Default map height in dp; style.height takes precedence when provided.
Default video height in dp; style.height takes precedence when provided.

web.description: Sandboxed local HTML rendered in a WebView. This component accepts inline HTML, not a remote page URL, and exposes no JavaScript bridge.

html.description: Inline HTML limited by the parser to 64 KiB of UTF-8 bytes.

height.description: Default WebView height in dp; style.height takes precedence when provided.
Default spacer height in dp; style.height takes precedence when provided.
